Such an honor! 

Our nonprofit org @stopTDV is being honored for our work to prevent violence affecting young people.

We would ❤️ to engage with more #PublicHealth professionals interested in our unique program. 

Since 2008, we have produced & published dozens of trauma-informed #videogames intentionally designed to foster protective factors & support the well-being of young people.
